method: After a choke the source presses Use on the unconscious body: the native carry (state 45, a pickup scene, the body attached to the player's shoulder) runs in the source's world. The source streams the carry action with the carried body's identity (spawner and definition, resolved in the observer's world NPC catalog, kept on large maps since 1214dx); the partner plays the native carry presentation (bank carry clips: lift, shoulder idle and walk, drop, throw), and the observer attaches its own copy of the body to the partner through the native snapshot blend and attachment (1214dq-1214dv: the host reuses a flag-only binding, so Emily's carry attaches there too). A drop (state 46) releases the body to native physics; a throw (RT while carrying) launches it with the source's throw velocity. Harness Test-CarryBody 1277/1423/1428 chokes the upper-floor guard, picks him up, walks 2.5 s, then drops or throws him over the railing, compares the body in both worlds after it settles, and films the lift (1428), the carry and the release. A case passes when the source carried natively, the remote presented every phase and the body ends within 0.5 m in both worlds.

items.scope: The partner lifting an unconscious body onto the shoulder, standing and walking with it, dropping it and throwing it, in both roles, with the observer's own body attached and ending where the source's body ends.

visual.verdict: Emily bends over the choked guard, reaches down and rises with him over her shoulder, then stands with him (backlit, silhouette).
Corvo bends over the guard lying at his feet, gathers him up and rises with him on his shoulder, then stands with the body on the shoulder.
Corvo walks with the guard over his shoulder, then lowers him to the floor at his left side and stands beside the body.
Emily walks with the guard draped over her shoulder, his legs hanging in front, then drops him.
Corvo walks with the guard over his shoulder, then the body leaves his shoulder to the left and drops past the railing while his left arm swings out.
Emily carries the guard over her shoulder, then the body slides off to her left and falls past the railing while her arm follows.
